name: garden-plugin-author
title_zh: 给 Obsidian 数字花园写插件
tagline_zh: 不用翻 Eleventy 源码，也不用记插件 API 的拼写。你描述功能，它生成 manifest、测试用例。
tagline_en: Skip the Eleventy source dive. Describe the feature, get a manifest, tests, and a community-registry submission.
desc_en: Create, test, and publish plugins for the Digital Garden Eleventy template (oleeskild/digitalgarden, used by the obsidian-digital-garden plugin and Forestry.md). Use when asked to build a garden plugin, add a feature to a digital garden as a plugin, write or edit a garden-plugin.json manifest, or publish a plugin to the community registry.
why_zh: 把「写插件」拆成可验证的步骤：先出清单，再写代码，最后跑测试。每一步都有明确产物。
why_en: Turns plugin creation into a verifiable pipeline: spec → code → test → publish. Each stage yields a concrete artifact, so you.
limit_zh: 只针对 oleeskild/digitalgarden 模板，不适用其他 Eleventy 主题。
limit_en: Only for oleeskild/digitalgarden, not other Eleventy themes. Requires Node.js & Git locally. Won't debug your plugin logic—only ensures manifest.
title_en: Build, test, and publish Digital Garden plugins from spec.
